stories.title: NeeDoh scarcity and GAIN look-through
stories.last_summary: NeeDoh scarcity persists at retail (Five Below purchase limits, Schylling direct-order pause); the public-market look-through is Gladstone Investment (GAIN) via Schylling preferred equity and term debt, with moderate NAV sensitivity.

stories.title: Target ACOTAR midnight events and Bloomsbury's two-book launch
stories.last_summary: Target's Oct 26-27 ACOTAR midnight release events intersect with Bloomsbury's two-book ACOTAR launch and an already signaled FY26/27 uplift; impact is moderate for Bloomsbury and de minimis for Target.
